item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. You've got check-ins, a moment to catch negative patterns before they run the show, and a question worth sitting with about projecting or mind-reading onto people. That's the theme today — noticing the story you're telling yourself before you treat it as fact. Your action: next time you feel a reaction spike, pause and ask what you actually know versus what you're assuming.
